name: issue-to-merge
description: GitHub issue and pull request workflow skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Manage issues through reviewed, CI-checked, explicitly merged PRs.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native GitHub workflow plugin for issue selection and multi-PR decomposition, pre-plan framing challenge, planning, post-plan solution challenge, implementation, PR submission, current-head self-review and code review, CI checking, human and automated review feedback, explicitly authorized merging, parent delivery tracking, branch rebasing, default-branch synchronization, and issue maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Run the full PR workflow for this issue.
Challenge this issue's necessity, scope, risks, and proposed solution.
Review this pull request and post findings.
